content.title: 'Worst movie I've ever seen': Guess the Irish film from its one-star review
content.text: Advertisement Bad reviews 'Worst movie I've ever seen': Guess the Irish film from its one-star review 20/09/2025 - 13:59 PM Can you match the Irish film to its one-star Letterboxd review? Take our quiz to find out! Photo: Getty Share this article Eva Osborne Prefer BreakingNews.ie on Google From gritty dramas and historical epics to offbeat comedies and cult classics, Ireland has produced some incredible films. But while critics and audiences might heap praise on these homegrown favourites, not everyone agrees. And nowhere is that more hilariously obvious than on Letterboxd, the film review site where opinions range from razor-sharp to completely unhinged. From cult classics to Oscar contenders, no title is safe from the wrath of Letterboxd keyboard critics. So, can you match the Irish film to its one-star Letterboxd review? Take our quiz to find out!
